items.text: word sets. Save a word sequence (its words, order and timing) as a set beside the sequence's play button, and tap a set to play it again. Sets live with your palettes and scenes
the list of palettes in the color editor gives way: tap a color slot, a tool, save, Escape or the new “back to the colors” row and you are back to editing
an update puts you back where you were: the scene on stage, its playing word sequence, its sound and water come back after the reload
an older Current left open in another tab or app no longer wipes words, palettes or scenes you add here: this window puts them back at once and tells you to reload the old copy
two current windows saving at the same moment keep both saves, and neither keeps writing over the other
while Performing, tapping a button still tells you what it did ("palette saved" was hidden)
Current open in two places on one device (an installed app and a browser tab) no longer writes one's old copy over the other's saves: each takes what the other saved
saving a palette checks that it was kept, and says so plainly if this browser's storage is full (the warning comes back after a minute instead of once a visit)
while Performing holds a newer version back, a small dot on the Index corner and a line under the version say it is waiting
a Pro key's error message runs across the whole Settings row instead of squeezing into the label's column
in Color › Palettes, each palette has an editor button beside its pencil: it puts the palette on and opens it in the Editor

the palette says whether your changes are kept: a palette of yours saves as you go (an undo and a ✓ saved after its pencil); a studio palette you changed shows undo and save (keep it as yours); undo puts the palette back to how it was when you put it on
